three_trajectories_if_window_is_authoriz.B1: Original-math primary baseline, fresh original30k restore through32000.
three_trajectories_if_window_is_authoriz.B2: Independent original-math repeat, fresh original30k restore through32000; same sampler/RNG/LR, evaluation and all49 endpoint.
three_trajectories_if_window_is_authoriz.V: Fresh original30k restore through32000, only same outside-opacity addition, paired with B1 and verified against B2 sampling.

pair_validity_before_interpretation: Same hashed original30k static/dynamic/environment/complete state; exact full restore observer PASS.
All2000 camera IDs, time_shift and learning_rates exactly match between B1/B2/V; finite losses, parameters and Adam states.
Only approved outside two-file math delta and two explicit config fields; same50k horizon and all other source/config/input/kernel/helper pins.
Every extra evaluation restores all RNG exactly; terminal all49 uses identical GT, dimensions, masks and region counts.
No33000 opacity reset, no densification/SGCM event; existing original hooks retained.
Each trajectory has complete32000 terminal all49 plus hashed, CPU-load-validated four-state snapshot and exit0.
primary_endpoint: 32000 all49 original frames; all nonempty frozen domains, no frame/region selection from outcomes.

primary_metrics.definition: Same frozen helper: any channel floor(clip(rgb,0,1)*255+0.5)>2. Eval dynamic excludes environment.

primary_metrics.purpose: Measure reconstruction preservation/tradeoff; no new tolerance chosen from results.

aggregation: Report every paired frame/domain metric and equal-frame mean over nonempty domains; report domain counts. Primary error summaries use MAE/MSE. ZeroMSE means infinite PSNR and is reported explicitly, never removed to improve means. Also report paired-frame difference distribution.
empirical_noise_reference: For each endpoint metric q report N=abs(mean(q_B2)-mean(q_B1)) and all49 paired abs(q_B2-q_B1); report candidate against B1 and B2 separately and mean(q_V)-(mean(q_B1)+mean(q_B2))/2. This is one observed repeat difference, not a confidence interval or bound on all possible CUDA noise.
interpretation_rules_locked_before_long_: Differences comparable to the measured original-repeat variation cannot exclude CUDA/original-math drift; first30001 exact is insufficient.

Directional support requires outside dynamic occupancy/support decrease and observed static background errors improve against both originals, with magnitude compared to observed original-repeat differences and all49 frame distribution reported. A single chosen good frame is insufficient.
If branch allocation improves but composite reconstruction worsens beyond observed repeat differences, report the tradeoff; do not call the result normal or a complete repair.

Exceeding this one repeat difference is descriptive directional evidence, not statistical significance, author-formula certification or from-zero evidence. No outcome-tuned thresholds or coefficient changes.
additional_context: Same frozen full/sky/non_sky/actor/outside_actor/non_sky_outside_actor domains and static/env/foreground arrays are retained.
Compare static Gaussian versus environment contribution, road images and actor-removal boundary/context in common frames0/10/20/30/48; terminal all49 remains mandatory.
Observed non-actor GT quantifies real-image preservation/locality. Inside selected actor removal areas there is no dense edited GT, so inspect qualitatively and do not claim removal accuracy/FID.

Only recovery from an already degenerated30k model is tested. The experiment cannot establish from-zero performance or author's true Eq13/background-domain formula. Prediction RGB masking and other paper ambiguities remain unchanged.
authorization: Root may decline this longer window after short300 results; materialization, CPU launchable plans, independent reviews, exact receipts and GPU handoffs remain separate future steps.
